verdict.rationale: Proa is a web framework, so a migration guide between incompatible major versions is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no dedicated version-migration guide. The closest items are `proa update` (a CLI self-update command) and incremental adoption alongside Next.js or Rails (migration from other frameworks). Both are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow a dedicated migration guide when moving between two incompatible major versions of the framework
